headline: Bitcoin Developer Proposes Quantum Defense Mechanism Using Collateral
summary: A Bitcoin developer has proposed a method requiring users attempting to move vulnerable Bitcoin to post matching collateral, allowing prepared owners to claim both.
why: Quantum computing poses a theoretical long-term threat to the cryptographic security of digital assets like Bitcoin.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Proposed protocol modifications could impact security assumptions for legacy holdings, though implementation is speculative.
